container_metrics.source: retained Prometheus container series bound to the exact Pod UID

diagnosis.oom_reason: The exact container peak was 31,424,692,224 bytes, 20,114,915,328 bytes below the 48 GiB limit; Kubernetes recorded no OOM or Killed event, and the driver emitted its own ValueError failure envelope.
diagnosis.early_identity_reason: The container remained active for about 138 seconds, consumed about 70 CPU-seconds, read about 477 MB, and reached a 31.4 GB cgroup peak, which requires the heavy native preflight path to have started.
remaining_stage_classes: native compiler preflight after heavy dataset/model preparation began
native receipt binding after compiler preflight returned
why_exact_stage_is_unrecoverable: The driver redirected native stdout and stderr into a private in-memory buffer.
Its only public failure envelope retained error class but neither a stage nor the exception text.
The Job used ttlSecondsAfterFinished=0, so the terminal Job and Pod were deleted before the separate observer could bind status or a termination message.
The collector accepted only successful terminal objects and had no failed-receipt path.
No PREFLIGHT.json or attempt-specific failure receipt exists.

smallest_safe_successor_design.terminal_resource_note: A finished zero-GPU Job retains only its control-plane object and terminal Pod evidence; it holds no active CPU or GPU allocation.
smallest_safe_successor_design.failure_envelope: Exact source hashes plus a bounded stage identifier, error class, and SHA-256 fingerprint of class and private message; never the message or private output.
smallest_safe_successor_design.collector: Validate exact Job, Workload, Pod, image, UID, attempt, source and nonzero exit before reading the one sanitized line; preserve it as PREFLIGHT_FAILED_Axx.json, never PREFLIGHT.json.
